question: How many team games does a freshly labelled injury actually cost?
method: createSession({seed:131,startYear:2026,controlledTeamId:'BUF'}), advance to the regular season, then 18 weeks through the real advanceWeek. A pass-through wrapper on gameDressedPlayers records the authoritative box-score game-day roster per week and which teams played. For each injury first observed after a week, games missed = consecutive later weeks in which the player's team played and he did not dress; weeks the team did not play (byes) are skipped; injuries still unresolved at season end are excluded. The before run uses the 1bd1807c source tree (git archive of src/ and public/); the after run uses the 970e5502 engine. Measured 2026-11-17; the probe script is a session-local tool, not shipped.
boundary: Engine measurement on one seed; not a player or balance outcome.
reading: Before, an injury cost one game fewer than its label (Out 1W: 297 of 316 missed none). After, the modal cost equals the label (Out 1W: 279 of 330 miss one); shorter costs are byes counted as served weeks, longer costs are re-injury or the roster's own handling. Questionable keeps players available, as intended.
